We need to detect explicit experiences mentioned.

Let's parse:

"設計部長として高品質を保つため三年かけて投資を行い、経営者としてその財務リスクとリターンを見極めた経験が..." So the person was a "設計部長" ("design department manager"). They invested over three years to maintain high quality. That is an experience of "投資" and "財務リスクとリターンを見極めた" as a manager.

It is an example of "技術・開発" because it's a design department manager (likely product development). And "経営者" denotes management; they "見極めた経験" refers to financial risk vs return. So perhaps "技術・開発" is clearly present; "危機対処" is not; "海外" not; "創業・立ち上げ" not; "人・組織" not; "その他" maybe. But the question might want all applicable categories. "経営者として財務リスクとリターンを見極めた経験" might be "経営者として" which is "経営" but not specific to the six categories.

The text doesn't mention crisis, development, overseas, start-up, people, organization, others. So only "技術・開発" applies.

Therefore JSON:

{"exp_types": ["技術・開発"], "confidence":"high"}
